  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `jobUrl` text NOT NULL,

  `company` text,
  `seenAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `seen_jobs_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
